summary: Verified CSS bug fix for mobile references carousel horizontal overscroll. All 4 acceptance criteria pass at 390x844 and desktop 1440x800. overscroll-behavior-x is now 'contain' on .refs__track, page has no horizontal overflow, carousel still scrolls via prev/next buttons, images render.

test_results.note_on_direct_scrollLeft_test: Setting .refs__track.scrollLeft=500 read back as 0 because scroll-snap-type:x mandatory snaps to nearest snap point. However clicking [data-carousel-next] moved scrollLeft from 0 to 348, confirming the carousel remains fully scrollable. Regression check for scrollability passes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: LupaTherm static site served from /app/site via /app/frontend/server.mjs. External URL https://lupatherm-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Cookie banner uses button text 'Elfogadom'. Mobile carousel .refs__track uses scroll-snap-type: x mandatory so direct scrollLeft assignments snap back to 0 — use [data-carousel-next]/[data-carousel-prev] buttons or scroll by card width increments to verify scrollability.
